rules.assert: start_pts < end_pts; time_base_num/den > 0; bounds inside media; interval [start,end)
decoded_pts requires all pts/timebase; sample_target must not be claimed precise
relative path has no .., drive, UNC or symlink escape; source root registered and authorized
content hash from canonical spec; immutable; parent belongs same shot
progress_done<=total; finishing requires current attempt/cancel epoch; resource released separately
manual has source null/run null allowed; failure never overwrites draft
scope must authorize exact reference; URL is citation not fetch instruction; credentials rejected
workflow/hash and parameter range in local allowlist; idempotency reconciliation before retry
all files within extraction root; total size/ratio bounded; manifest hashes validate before import
